units.source_text: 疯子们都穿着一摸一样的灰衣服。

en.t: The madmen were all wearing identical gray clothes.

units.source_text: 宽敞的屋子因此显得越发沉郁。

en.t: Because of that, the spacious room looked even gloomier.

units.source_text: 这中间有一个人对着风琴，沉浸在弹赞美歌当中。

en.t: Among them, one person sat facing the organ, absorbed in playing hymns.

units.source_text: 与此同时，中间另外一个人站在屋子正中间，沉浸在跳舞之中，不，应该是乱蹦着。

en.t: At the same time, another person stood in the very middle of the room, absorbed in dancing; no, it would be more accurate to say he was leaping about wildly.
